title: DialogWright slots.yaml
description: The app's slots by id, in the order they are filled and acknowledged. Lists every slot the app has: a library type with its options, or { type: code } for a slot the code writes.

noun.description: What the number identifies, as a noun without "number" ("account", "library card", "parcel tracking"). The default questions say "a <noun> number". Needed unless text gives every question in its own words.

article.description: The word before the noun in the default questions. Default: "an" when the noun starts with a vowel, otherwise "a".

length.description: How many digits the number has. Gives the default mask (exactly this many digits) and the length of the keypad rung. Needed unless mask is given.

mask.description: A regular expression (its source, no slashes) the digits must match, such as "^5\d{7}$" for eight digits starting with 5. Default: exactly `length` digits. A number that fails it is "invalid" with the reason "mask" (with only `length`, the reason is "length").

keypad.description: Whether the caller can key the number on the keypad, `length` digits at a time. Needs `length`, and an ask_<slot>_dtmf line.

group.description: How the number is said back, in groups of these sizes ([4, 4]: "5550 7788"). The last group takes any digits left over. Default: all digits together.

confirm.description: "summary": a spoken number is neither acknowledged nor read back on its own; the form's final confirm covers it. "by-confidence": it is acknowledged (ack_<slot>) when `readBack` says so.

readBack.description: What a filled number asks for: "implicit" (always), "below-fill" (only when the model is less sure of the span than SLOT_CHOICE_FILL), "none" (never). With `confirm: by-confidence`, "implicit" is what makes ack_<slot> be said.

minConfidence.description: A floor on how sure the model must be of the span: below this threshold the number is "invalid" (reason "low_confidence"). "none": no floor.

lengthRetryPromptId.description: The prompt that re-asks, in place of the generic ask_<slot>_retry, when what the caller said is not a number of the right shape ("A card number has eight digits.").

redact.description: How the value is masked wherever it leaves the turn (the trace, a tool call's param of the same name): "last4" ("...0417") or "none".

handoff.description: What a transfer to a person hands over: its "last4", only whether the caller was "verified", or its "display" in full.

text.description: Text to say to the model in place of a default, word for word, by part: given, span, none, complete.

given.description: The yes-or-no question that asks whether the caller states the number at all.

span.description: The question that asks which span of the caller's words is the number. Its choices are the spans the engine finds, and none.

none.description: What the span question's "none" choice means.

complete.description: The yes-or-no question that asks whether the caller said the whole number.

ids.description: Question ids in place of the defaults (the slot's id followed by the part: given, span, complete), to keep the ids an existing slot used.

given.description: The id of the question that asks whether the caller states the number.

span.description: The id of the question that asks which span of the caller's words is the number.

complete.description: The id of the question that asks whether the caller said the whole number.

oneOf.description: A number of a fixed shape that no list holds: an account, a library card, a tracking number.

what.description: What the caller gives, as a noun phrase the default question names ("a description of the problem"). Needed unless text.given gives the question in its own words.

instructions.description: More guidance for the model, added after the default question ("Count it even when it comes with a request.").

maxLength.description: The most characters of the caller's words the value keeps; the rest is cut off.

say.description: The display: what a line, the console and the model's turn state show in place of the words ("your note"). null: the words themselves.

keep.description: When a value is on file: "first-unless-prompted" replaces it only when the slot was just asked for; "first" never does. A correction at the summary replaces it either way.

redact.description: "length": the words leave the turn (the trace, a tool call's param) as their length only, and the display is kept. "none": as they are.

text.description: Text to say to the model in place of a default, word for word, by part: given.

given.description: The yes-or-no question that asks whether the caller gives the text, word for word.

ids.description: Question ids in place of the defaults (the slot's id followed by the part: given), to keep the ids an existing slot used.

given.description: The id of the question that asks whether the caller gives the text.

oneOf.description: The caller's own words, kept as said: a description, a note, a reason.

type.description: The slot is written in code: code.slots.<id>.

oneOf.description: A slot the app's code writes (code.slots.<id>), listed here so slots.yaml names every slot and sets their order.
